title: Update streaming guide + unify code tabs across Python/TS/Go (link-checked)
author: Wei Chen
release_notes: Docs: Streaming guide refreshed and code tabs standardized across Python/TypeScript/Go to match current SDK best practices (delta assembly, error handling, and consistent event naming).
description:
Context: We’ve had multiple user reports + internal reviews pointing out that the Streaming guide and the tabbed code examples drifted over time across languages (different event names, different assembly rules, and inconsistent error handling). This PR refreshes the Streaming guide content and updates the tabbed code blocks so Python/TypeScript/Go all reflect the same canonical mental model. Primary goals: (1) a single consistent pattern for consuming streaming events, (2) consistent guidance on assembling the final message from deltas, (3) clear handling of disconnects/errors, and (4) link hygiene while we migrate pages.

What changed:
- Streaming guide restructure:
  - Added an explicit “event loop mental model” section up front (iterate events, switch on event.type, accumulate deltas, finalize on message_end).
  - Added a “final message assembly” section that explains exactly what to append (content deltas) vs what to treat as metadata.
  - Added an “error + retry” section that calls out disconnects and safe re-request patterns.
  - Added a short “structured output while streaming” callout: do not parse partial JSON until final; validate then retry if invalid.
- Code tabs parity:
  - Python/TS/Go tabs now mirror each other in structure and naming (same section ordering, same event-handling branches, same logging guidance).
  - Removed older snippet variations that implied you’ll always get a complete tool-call args blob in a single event.
  - Added minimal comments that explain why partial tool-call arguments happen and what to do (buffer until tool_call_end / message_end).
- Link checks / hygiene:
  - Fixed/updated a handful of internal links referenced from the streaming page (some were renamed in-flight).
  - Added a small docs build-time link check invocation to the PR checklist and verified no new broken links.

Notes:
- This PR intentionally keeps the examples compatible with released SDKs. Where we wanted nicer ergonomics (e.g., helper for message assembly), we kept the docs code explicit and added a short note pointing to the SDK example directories.
- This PR does not change the docs site code-tab component itself; it only updates content and formatting. The UI bug tracked in INT-3321 is referenced here because it was discovered during verification; fix is handled in a follow-up PR.

Screenshots: Included in the PR conversation (before/after for Streaming page header + tabbed code blocks).
